verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents key-only SSH access to instances, with password authentication disabled, and SSH key management through its tooling. It also supports terminal access with port forwarding and VS Code, and lets users override the Docker entrypoint, while a community user confirms renters get a full Linux shell. Root-level control is only implied by the full shell and custom images rather than stated outright. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of root/sudo privileges inside the instance, a detailed first-party walkthrough of uploading your own public key, independent hands-on corroboration of SSH key setup.
